correctness.rationale: The quantity counts labeled starts and admissible half-lengths, including both sides of the circular cut and the full circumference, with rotations used only to choose one representative per cycle. The local pairing and Euler-tour proofs exhaust the cycles rooted at edge 00000. An independent reproduction used last exits instead: prescribe the last outgoing edge at each nonroot vertex, retain the directed last-exit trees leading to the root, and traverse in the corresponding fixed edge orders, with root edge 00000 first. Every tour gives such a tree because last-exit times strictly increase up to the root; a walk stopping early would stop at the root by balance, and any vertex with unused exits would lead along unused last exits to that exhausted root, a contradiction. This yielded 2048 unique normalized strings with all 32 five-bit factors. Integer masks and population counts compared both halves at every start and half-length; the resulting full 71-row histogram matches the actual CSV, all eleven gaps, endpoint counts and exact moments. Each extremizer set is the full size-four reversal/complement orbit of the stated example. For arbitrary positive order h, each length-2d factor with 2d≤h occurs 2^(h-2d) times; the qualifying strings are counted by Vandermonde, and no repeat is possible for a longer string because of its h-prefix. This proves the bridge independently of the census and gives the shift 20 at order five.
residual_risks: The frozen script compares with its hard-coded histogram rather than parsing spectrum.csv; the independent replay separately checked every actual CSV row and the endpoint examples.

value.rationale: Total cyclic occurrence density is a natural statistic for universal cycles: every short factor is forced, so differences isolate how the cycles arrange the longer windows. This is a complete order-five classification across all labeled rotation classes and all admissible lengths, rather than an arbitrarily selected window or cycle. The 71-bin distribution distinguishes typical values from rare endpoint orbits and records internal gaps; none is obtained from the unrestricted string count or the known single-length component. The lower orders are small by comparison (the independent sweep has one attained total at orders 1–3 and four at order 4). The joint value resides in the full finite spectrum and sharp extrema, not in claiming a general higher-order law.
residual_risks: No claim for higher order spectra or for type-count Abelian equivalence classes.
